title: Water Softener Recharge Interval Drift
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watersoftener:status
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(days_between_regen) as avg_days_between_regen by unit _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(avg_days_between_regen) as baseline_days_between_regen by unit
| where baseline_days_between_regen>0 AND avg_days_between_regen<baseline_days_between_regen*0.8
| sort avg_days_between_regen
description: Uses Water-softener telemetry telemetry to monitor changes in regeneration cadence over time in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for systems that are regenerating much more often than usual, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Water-softener telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly trend of days between regenerations.
grandmaExplanation: It totals changes in regeneration cadence over time so you can spot systems that are regenerating much more often than usual before it becomes annoying.
